Please take a clear, geotagged photo of every installer at this property. Unclear or incomplete evidence may be rejected by the Essential Services Commission (ESC).

Has the household or tenant been told the power will be off during installation?
Does anyone at this property rely on life support?

Have all Table 1 hazards been assessed and controlled in the SWMS?
Have the main and any alternative power supplies been isolated, locked out and tagged, and the roof cavity confirmed electrically safe to enter?
Before work starts, please take a clear, geotagged photo showing the power isolated, locked out and tagged. Unclear or incomplete evidence may be rejected by the Essential Services Commission (ESC).
Is there solar, a battery or another power supply, such as a generator?
Are safe shutdown, isolation and restart instructions available for every alternative power supply?
Is the ground-level AC/DC isolator accessible, working and safe to isolate?

How many recessed lights are there?

Does the PIESA confirm that all recessed lights are safe to cover with insulation?

Does the PIESA confirm all mains cables in the ceiling are TPS or an equivalent cable type?
Does the PIESA confirm all mains cables in the ceiling meet Basic Protection Requirements?
Has the owner or occupier confirmed that nobody has entered or worked in the ceiling since the PIESA?
Is there existing insulation in the ceiling?
What is the average depth of the existing insulation (mm)?
What is the existing insulation R-value, if known?
Will the existing insulation be removed, topped up, or both? Foil-backed or electrically conductive insulation must be removed.
Why is the existing insulation being retained?
Is the existing insulation suitable to lay new insulation over?

Before installation, please take a clear, geotagged photo of each product label showing the brand, model and R-value. Unclear or incomplete evidence may be rejected by the Essential Services Commission (ESC).
All information contained in and attached to this form is correct and not misleading by inclusion or omission
Signature
